title: AS2 to AVM1 bytecode: compile real frame actions into DoAction
description: 0045 emits frame scripts as trace stubs only — stop(), play(), gotoAndPlay() still do nothing in Test Movie, so even a stop-on-frame-1 interaction cannot be authored. Build on the AS2 tokenizer (0041) and parser (0043): compile the timeline-control subset to real AVM1 bytecode — stop, play, gotoAndPlay/gotoAndStop (frame number and label), nextFrame/prevFrame, stopAllSounds, getURL, plus trace — and emit proper DoAction tags replacing the stub. Emit FrameLabel tags from Frame.label (Tag.FrameLabel defined in tags.ts:16, never used) so goto-by-label works. Full AVM1 (variables, functions, MovieClip API) is follow-up scope, not this story. See docs/12-actionscript.md.
